g3:081f50eb.text: Nous, on surveille ici.\cHé, toi! Ne t'approche pas du CENTRE\nMETEO. C'est dangereux.
g3:081f50eb.provenance: The French cart's own line (pret pokeemerald multi-language, data/maps/Route119/text_fr.inc, which builds the French cart byte for byte); the French corpus row is empty while the other languages have the line.

gText_ApostropheSBase.provenance: The cart's own row, verbatim. It names the secret base's owner with STR_VAR_1, where the English row "'s BASE" follows the owner's name; gen1recomp fills it with the owner (src/core/game3/rse/secret_base.lua:602-606, SB.name, gen1recomp#2680, released in v0.3.52), as pret pokeemerald multi-language src/secret_base.c:732 does.

gText_Var1CertainlyHowMany2.provenance: The cart's own row, verbatim. It names the TM's move with STR_VAR_2, which the English line does not print but gen1recomp buffers for this key (src/ui/game3/rse/shop_menu.lua:240, say(shop, "gText_Var1CertainlyHowMany2", { name, moveName }), as pokeemerald/src/shop.c:1004 does).
